title: emg2pose: Surface EMG and Hand Pose
description: This dataset is a NEMAR re-host and EMG-BIDS conversion of the public Meta emg2pose benchmark for hand pose estimation from wrist surface electromyography. It contains 2 kHz, 16-channel sEMG recordings paired with joint-angle hand pose labels captured with a 26-camera motion-capture system. The release spans 193 users, about 370 hours, 29 behavioral stages, and roughly 80 million labeled frames.
methods_description: Wrist sEMG was recorded at 2 kHz with 16 channels, with hand pose labels from a 26-camera motion-capture rig. Upstream HDF5 recordings were converted to EMG-BIDS BDF files holding 16 EMG channels and 20 radian-valued joint-angle MISC channels. BAD_IK annotations mark samples where the inverse-kinematics labels are all zero.
